sentences.en: His depression came to an end when she kissed him.
sentences.zh: 她吻了他之后，他的忧愁终于结束了。

sentences.en: Depression is common among young adults who have Asperger syndrome.
sentences.zh: 患有阿斯伯格综合症的年轻人中，抑郁很常见。

sentences.en: Fadil came out of a severe depression thanks to Layla.
sentences.zh: 多菲亚在莱拉的帮助下走出了严重的抑郁状态。
